claim: In December 2017, Michigan State University economist Mark Skidmore and former HUD Assistant Secretary Catherine Austin Fitts reported that they had located U.S. government documents recording roughly $21 trillion in "unsupported adjustments" at the Department of Defense and the Department of Housing and Urban Development over the 1998–2015 period. The figure built on a July 2016 DOD Inspector General report (DODIG-2016-113) finding that the Army made $6.5 trillion in unsupported journal-voucher adjustments to its fiscal-2015 statements. "Unsupported adjustment" is an auditor's term for an accounting entry made without documentation showing where the money came from or went — it is a control failure and a record-keeping gap, not a finding that money was stolen. After the reporting, the Defense Department announced its first-ever department-wide financial audit (conducted 2018); it failed that audit and has failed every annual audit since.

sources.label: Michigan State University (MSUToday) — "MSU scholars find $21 trillion in unauthorized government spending; Defense Department to conduct first-ever audit" (Dec. 2017).
sources.quote: the Army had $6.5 trillion in unsupported adjustments, or spending, in fiscal 2015 ... a total $21 trillion in undocumented adjustments over the 1998-2015 period

sources.label: DOD Office of Inspector General, Report No. DODIG-2016-113 — "Army General Fund Adjustments Not Adequately Documented or Supported" (July 26, 2016): the $6.5 trillion FY2015 unsupported-adjustments finding.

notes: Distinct from 2001-rumsfeld-trillion-001, which covers Rumsfeld's Sept. 10, 2001 $2.3T statement; this record is the post-2001 continuation (Skidmore/Fitts $21T study + the $6.5T Army FY2015 IG finding + the chronic failed audits). Source reel (DZT_wZgx1YI, Catherine Austin Fitts) frames the same figures as a deliberate 'financial coup' — money 'stolen,' 'laundered through Epstein,' Americans 'poisoned.' Those are the creator's interpretation/caption (the Epstein-laundering and poisoning claims are not even in the spoken audio) and have no primary trace; they are logged Group C in the capture's editorial_split, NOT asserted here. The record states only what the IG documents and academic study establish — unsupported/undocumented adjustments — and marks where interpretation begins. See-also: 2001-rumsfeld-trillion-001.
